items.problem: Migration analyzer routes only files literally naming IBackgroundTask/BackgroundTaskBuilder to the background-tasks guidance; the common in-process model (BackgroundExecutionManager, BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup, SystemTrigger/TimeTrigger/ApplicationTrigger, Application.OnBackgroundActivated) is missed.
items.evidence: unsupported-api-inventory.json line 20 (pre-edit); migrated SampleConfiguration.cs/App.xaml.cs use the wider family (session-log.txt 294,304-305; SampleConfiguration.cs 82-118).
items.root_cause: Detection keyed to two tokens, missing the rest of Windows.ApplicationModel.Background + the OnBackgroundActivated activation hook.
items.change: Broaden the adaptable regex for the background-tasks anchor to the whole in-process family so any such file gets the TODO/routing (cannot be ignored by the agent).
items.expected_effect: Files touching background activation are flagged and routed to the background-tasks section during Initialize-UwpMigration, and surfaced by Validate-UwpMigration residue grep.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running Initialize-UwpMigration on a background-task app injects the background-tasks TODO even when only BackgroundExecutionManager / SystemTrigger / OnBackgroundActivated appear (no IBackgroundTask/BackgroundTaskBuilder token).

items.problem: Legacy background code migrated 1:1 compiles and renders but is behaviourally dead (Register never changes Status) because the packaged app lacks the windows.backgroundTasks manifest extension and Application.OnBackgroundActivated has no WinUI 3 override.
items.evidence: migration-score.json behavioral_note; Package.appxmanifest has no <Extensions>; MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md background-tasks section was 2 sentences.
items.root_cause: The background-tasks section recommends a model switch but never warns compiles!=works, never gives the OnBackgroundActivated transform, and never states the manifest-extension requirement.
items.change: Expand the existing background-tasks section (the anchor the Tier-1 analyzer already links to) with: a compiles-but-dead warning, the OnBackgroundActivated -> BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup.BackgroundActivated (App ctor) transform, and the windows.backgroundTasks <Extensions> manifest snippet.
items.expected_effect: Agent preserves background-task behaviour: drops the invalid override, wires the group, and declares the manifest extension so registration actually runs.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run migration of a triggered background-task sample declares the windows.backgroundTasks extension and the Register button flips Status Unregistered->Registered.

deferred_to_human: Eval-tool limitation: winui3-parity-check navigates by verbatim scenario title, so numbered ListBox titles ('1) ...') collapse all six frames to Scenario 1. Not fixable in the migration skill without reducing fidelity.
Eval-tool limitation: uwp-app-runner captured only the OS splash (CoreWindow never composed) and background registration is environment-gated, so no behavioural golden existed to confirm the fix.
